pilot_benchmark: math + code (retrofit, negative); referent construction (positive, N=28, 2 judges)
key_finding: Entanglement is a knob on TASK STRUCTURE, not phrasing. Retrofit onto LiC independent shards (math+code) destroys information (informed recoverability decays ~0.9->0.4) = difficulty confound. Referent construction (intent via assistant-introduced selections/callbacks/corrections) preserves information (informed stays high ~0.8-1.0) while blinded falls = faithful entanglement. On that regime, drop-assistant collapses (1.0->0.33) and decontextualize-then-edit holds (->0.88), reproducing Philippe's predicted matrix. Judge-robust discriminator = informed recoverability (faithfulness); the raw gap is judge-sensitive.
